name: teaching-writing
description: Write lecture slides, notes pages, puzzles, hints and explorable captions that teach, in the explanatory style of Dill & Bromberg adapted for slides.

interface.shortDescription: Write lecture material that explains, not just states.
interface.longDescription: Guidance for slides, notes pages, puzzles, hint ladders and explorable captions: picture first, every step, a number and its meaning, boxed key concepts and take-home messages.
defaultPrompt: Use Teaching Writing to revise these lecture slides.
Use Teaching Writing to write hints for this quiz.
